subject: Next steps on on-prem pilot and resourcing
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@finlytics.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + recommended next steps from today's discovery call

Hi Samantha / Tom,

Thanks again for the time today — good discussion. Quick recap and a suggested path forward so we stay aligned: 

TL;DR: Finlytics is evaluating an on-prem (air-gapped) pilot to host inference for regulated data; next steps would be a short SOW + pilot runway (4-6 weeks), security checklist handoff, and a resourcing confirmation from Finlytics ops.

Key points from the call:
- Goal: replace current GPU-hosted batch flow with sub-200ms inference for classification and extraction workloads inside Finlytics' on-prem environment.
- Data sensitivity: PHI-like financial identifiers; you need a customer-managed KMS and audit logging (retain logs 1 year).
- Scale: initial pilot ~2 instances, target steady-state ~12 concurrent streams.
- Timeline: target internal sign-off by end of Q1 to start pilot in April.

Suggested next steps (my recommended order):
1) We share our on-prem deployment outline and a high-level SOW (attached).
2) Your security/infra team completes the Redwood security checklist (we can walk through it together).
3) Confirm pilot contacts and resourcing (who will own infra ops, and do you have access to an air-gapped test cluster?).
4) Align on Milestones & success criteria; we can put a short MAP in HubSpot and iterate.

I've attached: redwood-onprem-outline.pdf and a pricing workbook for Dedicated/Private sizing. Also dropped a draft MAP template in the Drive link below for your review.

Can you confirm who on your side will own the air-gapped environment and whether your procurement team expects any special contract terms (e.g., SOC2 evidence, indemnity addendum)? If useful, Ben (cc'd) can join a technical call to walk through the KMS and network setup.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m follow-up next week if that helps.

Best,
Irene

Tom / Samantha —

Great — thanks for the update and the infra point of contact. Short answers below and attached a 1-pager to circulate with procurement/security. 

1) KMS: Redwood's Private deployment supports customer-managed key stores. We have an HSM/KMS integration layer and also a tested integration with HashiCorp Vault (your use case is supported). We'll include example config snippets in the attached 1-pager.

2) Initial node guidance: for the pilot we typically recommend 2x A10G-equivalent GPUs with 64GB RAM for each node if you're running mixed extraction/classification with modest concurrency. If you expect longer context windows or higher throughput we can size to A100- or H100-equivalent nodes; Ben can run a quick perf estimate once you share token/throughput targets.

Attachments included: mutual-action-plan-template.docx, redwood-onprem-install-summary.pdf (1-pager), redwood-dedicated-pricing.xlsx (pricing workbook).

Proposed next steps:
- Samantha: can you confirm target throughput (reqs per minute) and whether Vault is already running in your air-gapped environment?
- I'll get Ben to prepare a short perf/budget estimate by Thursday.
- I'll also upload a draft MAP to the Drive link and create the HubSpot deal with the milestones.

If it's helpful, let's do a 20m technical sync Thursday at 11am PT — otherwise reply with availability.

Best,
